source_text: Regret dynamics further complicate this: while direct studies on adult regret for neonatal non-circumcision are sparse, surveys indicate that uncircumcised men rarely seek later intervention absent acute issues like phimosis, implying deferred decisions may forfeit cumulative protections, such as a 10-fold UTI risk reduction in the first year of life achievable only through early intervention. [1]
